scope: Reviewed peer82 source input, not final merged image or runtime evidence
result: Vendor unregister alone is insufficient for WDS callback retirement

sources.finding: Removes table entry under irq_lock; does not join readers. wdev_search_by_address returns raw pointers without a read-side lifetime lease.
RX loads raw wdev then dereferences VLAN_VID; table removal alone cannot retire a previously loaded pointer.
Optional BLOCK_NET_IF path reads table and stores if_dev in a blocked queue; configuration and queue drain must be proven separately.
Checked block/drain precedes tasklet kills and joined receipt. This is a candidate global RX barrier, not proof of all management/timer/network callback retirement.

next_action: Bind a source-backed global RX/worker retirement receipt on PCI teardown before vendor unregister; inventory management/timer and queued netdev references before allowing registry finish. Preserve normal per-interface operation without globally stopping unrelated interfaces.
limitations: No target feature enablement inferred for BLOCK_NET_IF
Do not use this peer input to claim downstream init-join/WDS generation layers are absent

verification.result: PASS under ASan/UBSan: actual extracted unregister leaves prior raw reader live even after table slot reuse; object deliberately retained
verification.meaning: Counterexample to unregister-as-join, not successful retirement
